title: GRPO · rank 1 alpha 1 lr 5e-4
analysis: Matched-effective-LR arm: GRPO, rank-1 LoRA alpha 1 (scale 1), LR 5e-4, so alpha/rank x lr is about the alpha-32 baseline's 32 x 1.5e-5 = 4.8e-4. 32 prompts x 8 rollouts, token_mean, no KL, no clipping, 100 updates, AIME25+AIME26 avg@8 every 20, logs only. Learns much faster than the alpha-32 baseline at matched nominal effective LR, indicating the alpha/LR split matters under AdamW beyond their product.
